_about: Issues stated on mod pages that the data checks can't see. Keyed by the new mod's slug (nexus<id> or modio<id>); shown when the 'if_installed' pak is installed.

nexus12727.text: Ancient Mega Pack's page says saves crash at 70% loading when AMP runs with DnD 5.5e. The fix is AMP Plus together with the 'Ancient Mega Pack - DnD 5.5e BEYOND patch' on mod.io.

DnD 5.5e stops at level 12. Its levels 13-20 come from a separate mod, 'Path to Apotheosis - Levels 13-20 for DnD 5.5e All-in-One' (Nexus 25717); Unlock Level Curve's 13-20 levels were built for the base-game classes.
